prompt_text: Who is the best mortgage lender in St. Charles MO for a home purchase loan?
competitors_mentioned: Loan Estimates on the same day
engine_stated_criteria: A good local starting point is Guild Mortgage’s St. Charles office
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one universally “best” lender—the right choice depends on your credit, down payment, loan type, and how much you value service versus price. **A good local starting point is Guild Mortgage’s St. Charles office**, which has local loan officers and purchase-loan experience; one officer, Melinda Movick, has strong customer-review feedback in the search results. **Integrity Mortgage of Missouri** in nearby Cottleville is another local option, with a reported 4.8/5 rating from 37 Google reviews.

Before choosing, get written **Loan Estimates on the same day** from at least three lenders, including one local lender and one bank or credit union. Compare the interest rate, APR, lender fees, points, and closing timeline—not just the advertised rate. Ask each lender to quote the same loan type, down payment, and rate-lock period.

Local options to contact:
- Guild Mortgage, St. Charles: [office details and reviews](https://www.experience.com/reviews/office/st-charles-127891)
- Integrity Mortgage of Missouri, Cottleville: [website and contact details](https://integritymo.com/)
- First State Bank, St. Charles: [mortgage lending team](https://fsbfinancial.com/about-us/locations/2850-west-clay-street/)

Rates and eligibility are personalized, so I wouldn’t rely on a rate table or review score alone to pick a lender.
